tests.name: TestRealGuestPreparedRuntimeSingleUseParity
observations: fixed memory reported as COW candidate while COW remained unselected

tests.name: TestRealGuestCOWSingleUseOutcomeIsolation
observations: COW selected with no fresh fallback
imported module state did not leak
every request used a single-use slot

interpretation: Outcome-qualified Experimental Linux COW. Each request uses a fresh MAP_PRIVATE slot from a sealed fixed-memory baseline; served, cancelled, failed, or pressure-exposed slots are discarded, not pooled or reset for reuse.
